text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto was running up the sloped track,
lap after lap after lap.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Japan Cup~. Japan Cup~.
With my sparkling self,
I'll be of help to Opera O-san~."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, but neither my time nor my results are improving~.
No matter how many times I run, I just can't...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The reason is... a lack of fighting spirit. It's obvious now. As long as you keep adoring T.M. Opera O, you cannot move forward past this point.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Doto, got a minute?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I exchange a glance with Admire Vega.
I have to tell her what needs to be said.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san, what should I do?
Even though Opera O-san acknowledged me, I feel like I'm not really running all that well~...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I think it's... only natural.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Because you're being soft. Because you're picking the wrong opponent to beat.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'll never become strong like this...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh...
Ayabe...-san, the opponent you have to defeat is...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Doto. Who is the opponent you must defeat?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Umm... The opponents I have to run against and beat are...
Special Week-san,
and Grass Wonder-san...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —No.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Trainer, who's that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I have to say it.
Clearly and directly, as her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Umm... the opponent we're supposed to beat is...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The wind... has stopped.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O...-san... Ope...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um... isn't that a bit off? Well~ I might win every now and then, but...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
That's... not true...
Because Opera O-san is...
choice_data_list: They're a rival you have to surpass, right?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
We're not rivals.
Opera O-san is someone I look up to... my goal~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Noooo! That's not true at alllll!
It's really notttt...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto began to struggle
in her desperate bid to protect what was dear to her.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san is...
Opera O-san and Trainer are the only ones
who will always be on my side...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san has always...
always been someone I looked up to...
I wanted to become just like her...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san told me I was sparkling,
and gave me so much confidence, and yeeet...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Doto, then that confidence of yours—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You mean it'll disappear once Opera O is gone, right? Are you okay with that?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Opera O, whom you admire so much.
What is the driving force behind that brilliance?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
That would be—her infuriatingly boundless confidence.
Opera O would never, ever leave
her fate in someone else's hands.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: As long as you stay sheltered under that umbrella, you'll never become a confident Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
At first... that might have been fine.
But—our season has changed.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Besides, if you don't change,
Opera O will be backed into a corner just the same.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
The generation above is strong. Unless you have the drive to surpass Opera O,
inspire Opera O, and grow together, you won't stand a chance.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly, one distant summer...
Opera O said something like that.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: We will leave our generation's hoofprints—etched into history.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Such a dream would never come true,
and we would end up going down together.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What you do is entirely... up to you.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
No way... If things stay like this...
I'll go back to how I used to be...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: To prevent that from happening... I need the mindset to defeat Opera O-san...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Auu, but anything but this...
Anything but this... No matter what...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"There is no way on earth I could feel that way,
Traaiiineeer-saaan!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I must gently untangle
the knots in Meisho Doto's heart.
One by one, with care...
choice_data_list: You don't want to go back to how you used to be, right?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Th-That is...
choice_data_list: You want to become your most sparkling self, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Uuugh, okay... But, but, but...
choice_data_list: It would also be a way to repay T.M. Opera O.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Repaying Opera O-san...
I have to...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Still... but...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"One final push. Though Meisho Doto had spent all this time in the shadow of T.M. Opera O,
she had steadily pressed forward."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It might be true that Meisho Doto has never
"awakened on her own."
Even so...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Eeeh, my body hasn't hit its
growth spurt yet? U-Uuuu..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'll try my best, little by little!
Even if it might be impossible, step by step...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Not just my body, my heart hasn't even hit its growth spurt yet either...
U-Uuuugh...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Still, I wanna do things that'll help me grow~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, what's going on~?
My dash times aren't improving as much as I thought they would~

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
One more! Please, just one more!
I have to do something. Anything~...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: No matter how inexperienced she was, no matter how immense the wall before her, Meisho Doto always—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not once has she ever
'given up on her own.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: So this time too—
choice_data_list: You're strong. You can't just give up, right?
You're strong. You can't give up now, can you?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Trai...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ugh!? Ughhh...
I... I am... I aaaaam!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeeees, I can't give up nowww!
I don't wanna lose to Opera O-san either, waaaah!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHN!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A feeling buried deep beneath an inferiority complex all along.
"Deep down, I want to win."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As long as that stays deeply rooted in her heart,
Meisho Doto will not stop.
No matter how slow she may be, she will keep moving forward."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm... gonna try...
declaring them my rival...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Becoming different versions of Opera O-san
and myself... It's scary, but...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I will say it! I'm challenging... Opera O-san!
For myself, and for Opera O-san's sake,
I have to, I have to... I have to change!"
